summary: The fixes for F1–F4 are acceptable. A failed or slow remote link lookup now falls back to the stored URLs after a five-second timeout, and the new temp tests cover the forwarding, the link refresh, the account editor UI, and the handoff guards. One changed line is still uncovered: the warning in `ExtensionHost.refresh` when a refresh fails (line 114). The coverage gate fails until it is tested or exempted.

findings.body: The coverage report lists the `extension-links-refresh-failed` warning in `refresh()` as uncovered. This branch runs only when the local part of `listUnqueued` fails, meaning a manifest read or `publication.list()` error, because remote failures now fall back without an error. Add a temp test that makes a refresh fail, for example by corrupting the stored publication file or a running extension's manifest before `renamePublisher`. It should assert that the rename still succeeds and that watchers receive the error snapshot. Alternatively, add a `coverage-exempt` comment that explains that this is a logging-only path for local filesystem failures.

testRequests.target: packages/workspace-server/src/extensions/ExtensionHost.ts:113-115 — refresh after rename when the local listing fails
testRequests.rationale: This is the only changed executable line that is still uncovered, and the coverage gate fails on it.
